title: App actions descriptor (app-actions/v1)
description: A versioned, data-only declaration of the record mutations a workspace app package may describe: named actions, each a closed record.create or record.update operation on a declared record kind, carrying closed typed input-field definitions. The descriptor is data, never code and never authority — it cannot carry executable surfaces (script/code/html/css/eval/import/module), URLs or navigation (url/href/src/link/endpoint/method), scope or actor identity (install_id/context_id/workspace/project/actor/by/role), credentials or storage internals (secret/credential/token/password/sql/query/path/file), authority claims (effect/verified/digest/revision) or guard-weakening toggles (revision_pin/approval_pin/actor_request/guard/caller/public/unauthenticated/skip_approval). The host alone derives the actor, derives the context and enforces the operation's guard floor; a declaration can narrow, never widen. Identifier grammar is [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}. Consumers must also enforce the bounds documented here (max actions/fields/enum values, string lengths, unique action and field ids, and the closed operation vocabulary) — JSON Schema alone cannot express duplicate ids or the consumer's recursive forbidden-key scan.

contract.description: The contract tag. A descriptor naming any other version is refused.

app.description: The workspace-app kind this descriptor was reviewed with (e.g. crm, ledger). Provenance only — never an installation id, route, or authority claim.

title.description: Human title for the descriptor — plain text.

actions.description: Declared actions; ids unique within the descriptor (consumer-checked).

id.description: The input field's declared identifier — unique within its action (consumer-checked).

type.description: Closed input vocabulary, mirroring the shared host controls. An absent type is text.

required.description: Whether the host's form must collect a value. Data only — the host owns whether an operation is permitted at all.

values.description: Closed allowlist a type "enum" field may equal — required on enum, forbidden on every other type (consumer-checked).

maxLength.description: Optional declared cap on a text/tags item's length — a request, not authority; the host enforces its own bound regardless.

maxItems.description: Optional declared cap on a tags list's length — a request, not authority.

fields.description: The closed typed inputs the action's host form may collect; ids unique within the action (consumer-checked).

id.description: The action's declared identifier — a dotted name like "customer.create", unique within the descriptor (consumer-checked). Data only; never a route.

title.description: Human title for the action — plain text.

operation.description: The closed v1 operation vocabulary: a named semantic reference to a host operation, never a method, URL, SQL or arbitrary verb. record.delete, custom verbs and every outward effect are refused in v1.

record.description: A reference to a record kind the package declares elsewhere (a future domain/ contract). This descriptor only records the name — validation against a declared domain is a later admission requirement, not expressible here.
